azureLogAnalytics.query:
CompassLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= $__timeFrom() and TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo()
| where owner_layer_lake_s == "bronze"
| where success_count_d > 0
| summarize TotalExecucoes = count()
  by owner_layer_lake_s
| order by TotalExecucoes desc

CompassLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= $__timeFrom() and TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo()
| where owner_layer_lake_s == "bronze"
| extend rawTempo = tostring(total_processing_time_s)
| extend TempoProcessamentoSegundos = todouble(extract("([0-9]*\\.?[0-9]+)", 1, rawTempo))
| where isnotempty(TempoProcessamentoSegundos) and isfinite(TempoProcessamentoSegundos) and TempoProcessamentoSegundos > 0
| summarize TempoMedio_s = round(avg(TempoProcessamentoSegundos), 2)
  by bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
| order by TimeGenerated asc

CompassLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= $__timeFrom() and TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo()
| where owner_layer_lake_s in ("bronze", "silver", "gold")
| summarize 
    TotalValid = sum(todouble(column_ifexists("valid_data_count_d", 0)))
  by owner_layer_lake_s

CompassLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= $__timeFrom() and TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo()
| where owner_layer_lake_s in ("bronze", "silver", "gold")
| summarize 
    TotalValid = sum(todouble(column_ifexists("invalid_data_count_d", 0)))
  by owner_layer_lake_s

CompassLogs_CL
| where TimeGenerated >= $__timeFrom() and TimeGenerated <= $__timeTo()
| where owner_layer_lake_s == "bronze"
| extend 
    Duplicados = todouble(column_ifexists("duplicate_count_d", 0.0)),
    Nulos = todouble(column_ifexists("null_count_d", 0.0)),
    Consistente = column_ifexists("validation_results_consistency_check_status_b", true)
| extend 
    Inconsistente = iff(Consistente != true, 1, 0)
| summarize 
    TotalDuplicados = sum(Duplicados),
    TotalNulos = sum(Nulos),
    TotalInconsistentes = sum(Inconsistente)
